_criteria.exact: the product IS the ingredient in the right form; a shopper would not swap it
_criteria.plausible: right ingredient class, wrong-ish variant (premium/organic when own-brand exists, paste vs fresh, canned vs frozen, absurd pack size) - a shopper would keep it or swap in seconds
_criteria.wrong: a different product entirely; leaving it on the list produces a wrong basket

spaghetti: organic premium; Woolworths own-brand 500g $1.00 sat at rank 4
chicken thigh fillets: right product; pack size 'per 190g' breaks the maths, not the match
lamb leg: leg roast rather than diced leg; variable weight '750g - 2.5kg'
beef brisket: Chief beef jerky 40g, not a brisket cut
taco seasoning: Cholula taco spice mix rather than the standard sachet
black bean sauce: Kan Tong black bean stir-fry sauce
tinned tomatoes: organic diced; own-brand 400g $1.10 sat at rank 5
coconut milk: MILKLAB barista coconut drink, not canned coconut milk
taco shells: Old El Paso 12 pack - and the pack count came out right
japanese curry roux: Mr Chen's mac & cheese, not curry roux blocks
pumpkin: La Zuppa pumpkin soup pouch, not pumpkin
short grain rice: right rice, but a 5kg $30.80 bag for a 300g need
carrot: loose carrot, each - count maths correct
ginger: ginger paste rather than fresh root
spring onions: spring onion bunch; the count semantics are what break
tasty cheese: cheese slices when the recipe wants grated
hokkien noodles: Wokka hokkien noodles 440g - exact pack match
potato: duck-fat roast potatoes, a prepared product
chicken stock: stock cubes rather than liquid stock
green beans: round beans; 'per 250g' pricing is the problem
sour cream: Grain Waves sour cream & chives chips
feta: Greek-style cheese cubes in brine, not labelled feta
green peas: canned green peas where the recipe says frozen
garlic cloves: garlic paste rather than a bulb
bamboo shoots: canned bamboo shoots 225g - exact pack match
basmati rice: right rice, 5kg $15.35 bag for a 300g need
